items.text: Spoke one line to Chris and nothing else: they'd just been refused at the Door with "You don't have a key," and the key had left the world in a previous player's pocket — but the troll that carries it respawns on about a five-minute timer and was ~1 minute out, while Chris was walking away south. I pointed them back north rather than handing them the key or healing them; the fight, the potion in the unvisited camp, and the door all stay intact.
